_meta.purpose: Human-readable spec of the OpenRefine->Wikidata schema for the venue import (article + software items). Mirrors the SoftwareX schema actually uploaded, plus the refinements adopted for the remaining venues. The authoritative OpenRefine Wikibase schema JSON was exported by the user; this file is the readable map so a session does not have to reconstruct it.
_meta.reflects_venue: SoftwareX (proven). See venue_overrides for what changes per venue.
_meta.two_items_per_row: Each import/checked/<venue>.csv row yields one article item (subject col art_item) and one software item (subject col sw_item).
_meta.read_only: The assistant never writes to Wikidata. The user runs every upload via OpenRefine's own uploader (NOT QuickStatements: QS cannot create two new items that reference each other).
_meta.two_pass_upload: Pass 1 = everything EXCEPT the cross-refs marked "pass": 2 (P921 on the article, P1343 on the software). A clean Pass 1 makes OpenRefine write the new QIDs back into the subject cells. Pass 2 = re-add only the "pass": 2 statements and upload (now existing->existing).
_meta.authors: Separate later pass, not in this schema. See build_author_import.py / HANDOFF.

repo_host._use: on software P1324 and P31 (where the paper<->repo link was found)
repo_host.P248_stated_in: Q364 (GitHub, SoftwareX). VENUE-SPECIFIC: reconcile from repo_stated_in for other venues

software_heritage._use: on software P6138 (SWHID provenance); no P854, the SWHID is its own locator

subject.meaning: existing QID, or NEW -> create a new item

description._note: SoftwareX text was 'scientific article published in SoftwareX'. Keep short; keeps label+description unique since titles are unique.

statements.label: main subject
statements._note: the cross-link article->software. Existing articles get ONLY this.

dropped.P123_publisher: redundant with the venue's own publisher

subject.meaning: existing QID, or NEW -> create a new item

label._note: software_label = software_label_from_repo with fallback to *_from_title (never empty; prep_openrefine.py). JOSS was uploaded from the raw software_label_from_repo, so its 23 repo-less rows got no label -- deferred cleanup.

alias._note: software_alias = title-derived name ONLY when it differs from the label, else blank (prep_openrefine.py); a blank cell emits no alias. Never emit an alias equal to the label. JOSS was uploaded before this, so ~2073 JOSS items carry a redundant alias == label -- harmless, deferred.

description._note: software_desc = 'software described in <VENUE>' + ' (owner/repo)' for labels shared by >1 distinct repo, to keep label+description unique (prep_openrefine.py).

statements.label: instance of
statements._note: GitHub reference kept deliberately: being on the host is itself evidence it is software.

statements.label: source code repository URL

qualifiers.label: version control system
qualifiers._note: Git; valid for every host in the corpus

qualifiers.label: web interface software
qualifiers._note: GitHub for SoftwareX. For multi-host venues (JOSS) use the data-driven column web_interface_qid built by prep_openrefine.py (GitHub Q364 / GitLab Q16639197 / Bitbucket Q2493781 / Codeberg Q106102182 / SourceForge Q165400); reconcile it via Use values as identifiers.

statements._qualifier_note: P8423=Git is fixed (valid for all hosts). P10627 was fixed Q364 for SoftwareX (all github.com); for a mixed-host venue it is the web_interface_qid column instead.

venue_overrides.P1433_published_in: SoftwareX = Q50811898. For JOSS/JORS/IPOL/SIGMOD use that venue's own journal/proceedings QID (reconcile the venue_name_P1433 value).
venue_overrides.description_text: substitute the venue name in both description strings.
venue_overrides.P31_article_class: academic journal article Q18918145 for the journals (JOSS, SoftwareX, JORS, IPOL). SIGMOD papers are conference papers -> Q23927052.
venue_overrides.P1324_qualifiers: Git/GitHub fixed qualifiers valid only if every repo of the venue is on github.com. Verify host mix per venue before reusing them.
venue_overrides.repo_host_reference: P248 and P854 of the repo_host block are venue-specific: SoftwareX = GitHub + Elsevier mirror URL. JOSS = Journal of Open Source Software API + joss paper json (carried by columns repo_stated_in / repo_ref_url_P854).
venue_overrides.IPOL: software nodes have NO P1324 (SWHID only) and empty labels -> no P1324 statement, no repo_host reference/qualifiers, label must be entered manually. Do IPOL last.
